name: The Sims 4: Yard Charm Kit
summary: Adding charm to your Sims lawn isn’t about perfection—it’s about personality. Go full yardcore with The Sims 4 Yard Charm Kit! This playful collection turns plain porches and tired lawns into cozy corners bursting with color. Mix and match modern tones, textures, and timeless details to create a handcrafted look for any neighborhood. Your Sims will stay stylish, social, and totally keeping up with the Goths. Created by Ravasheen.
